problem: Which of the following functions is differentiable at the point $x=-2?$
worked_solution:
Notice that the function $p(x)$ is differentiable for all real number $x.$ Therefore, the correct answer is $p(x)=\operatorname{sin}⁡x.$

All other functions are not differentiable at $x=-2.$

- The function $f(x)$ is not defined at $x=-2$ and hence it is not differentiable there.

- The function $g(x)$ has a corner point at $x=-2$ and hence it is not differentiable there.

- The function $h(x)$has a vertical tangent at $x=-2$, and hence it is not differentiable there.

- The function $q(x)$ has a jump discontinuity at $x=-2$ and hence it is not differentiable there.
